problem: Two independent limit(100) queries selected shipper profiles and availability records. Unrelated availability rows could displace the selected shippers and incorrectly report them as unavailable.

change.profiles: Keep the existing first 100 shipper profiles and disabled-account filtering; fetch only displayName, phoneNumber, photoURL and disabled.
change.availability: Query by document IDs of the selected enabled profiles, in disjoint batches of at most 30, projecting available and lastSeenAt. An empty roster issues no availability query.
change.failure: A failed availability query still fails the request. Missing records or missing available fields retain the existing unavailable default.
change.authorization: The current administrator check still precedes all dispatch business reads. No raw order, payment or OTP permissions change.

fixtures: 140 unrelated presence rows before the visible roster; active, disabled, missing and legacy records.
105 shipper profiles retain the existing 100-profile scope with four disjoint availability batches.
No profiles, all disabled profiles, availability updates/removal and profile disabling.
A one-delivery page retains the complete active-job count and distinct next cursor.
Authorization failure before collection reads and availability-read failure propagation.

release.prerequisite: Merge the named-database rules workflow correction before dispatching this scoped release.

remaining: The existing 100-profile cap still needs a real roster cursor.
Whole-scope count queries, per-page GPS reads and the dispatch 30-second refresh remain unchanged.
Query groups have overhead; field projection reduces returned payload but does not by itself prove lower billed read units. Measure representative production traffic before claiming a cost saving.
